summary: Take foundation-level Angular training in components, routing, APIs and forms. Practise by building a working application; explore the course.
lede: Angular development uses TypeScript, components and services to build browser-based applications. For aspiring frontend developers and software teams, the course offers hands-on practice building a small application by composing components and templates, configuring routes and API data access, and validating forms. Learners also use Angular testing utilities to check core user flows.
audienceIntro: This course suits people beginning Angular development or moving from basic web development into structured, component-based applications. It is designed for roles that build, support or test browser-based interfaces.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with HTML, CSS and JavaScript is expected. Coding is required: you will edit TypeScript and Angular code. Bring a laptop with a current Node.js LTS release, Angular CLI and a code editor installed; a modern browser is also required.
